mentions.name: Burn Them APIs
mentions.description: A native macOS API client built entirely with SwiftUI and AppKit, featuring 10 UI themes including Nord and Monokai. It has been used daily for personal development work.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I developed my first macOS app, an API client built purely with SwiftUI/AppKit. It has themes like Nord, Monokai and 8 others. Been using it for my own personal use for the past 6 months.

https://apps.apple.com/us/app/burn-them-apis/id6758321600
